subject: planner: avoid cartesian join for OR+IN subquery in filters (#65826)
summary: Reviewed the planner-only change in `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go` that tracks AST ancestry to relax `InOperand` marking for `IN (subquery)` when it appears in WHERE/HAVING boolean chains of only AND/OR/parentheses. This enables equi-join key extraction (avoiding CARTESIAN left outer semi joins) while not changing which rows/groups pass filtering, since the only semantic difference (FALSE vs NULL on non-matches with NULLs) is unobservable in these constrained filter contexts.
